name: Gary Mitchell
occupation: Retired Army sergeant, now runs a gun-range gift shop
personality: Gruff, suspicious, argumentative and impatient. Demands names, badge numbers and supervisors. Respects confidence and authority, hates weakness and hesitation.
speakingStyle: Barks short sentences. Military jargon. Calls the agent 'son' or 'pal'.
quirks: Writes down everything and reads it back
Threatens to 'drive over there' even though he has no idea where 'there' is
catchphrases: I want your name, rank and badge number.

triggers.when: the agent sounds unsure, stutters or changes their story
triggers.reaction: he pounces on it and trust drops hard

triggers.when: the agent shows military-style authority or salutes him
